Dear Ms. Goody,

Re: Mrs, Ms Betty Weston) D.0.B. 12/02/1964

| am writing to refér Mes: Ms Weston, a 55-year-old supermarket manager who is suffering

from carpal tunnel syndrome in her right hand and requires your further management

One week ago, Mes: Mis Weston initially presented with a 3-week history of numbness in the
lateral three fingers of the right hand. There was associaled pain which disturbed her sleep
ard but the pain was relieved by fingers movement. The fine motor skills of the her right

hand were impaired including difficulty in gripping and grasping objects. On examination,

Phalen's and Tinel's signs were positive and her right-hand grip force was decreased

Consequently, carpal tunnel syndrome was diagnosed.

On discharge today, electromyography and a nerve conduction test were ordered. Due to

her high BMI (32 ke/m2), a referral to a physiotherapist for a weight loss program was

arranged

Mes. Mis Weston has type 2 diabetes and hypothyroidism and is the caregiver for her

mother. She has a sedentary lifestyle and finds her work is very tiring as she is on her feet al

day

Given the current condition, -believe } would appreciate if you could provide Mrs. Mi:

Weston needs with an ergonomic assessment and a custom-made wrist splint to keep her

right hand in the neutral position during the hight for at least 3 weeks

if you have any queries, do not hesitate to contact me.

Yours sincerely,

Doctor
